title: The Dragon's Gift
synopsis: An ordinary farmer discovers a dragon egg, hatches it, and bonds with the silver dragon Yinzhu, changing his village's fate forever.

characters.personality: Humble and hardworking, secretly longing for adventure, compassionate and brave when it matters

source_chunks: Wei Chen was an ordinary farmer in the village of Qinghe.
One autumn day, while clearing brush near the old mountain cave, Wei Chen stumbled upon a large jade-green egg.
He took the egg home and kept it by the hearth.
